description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named SupervisorEvaluationSearchFilterParams, used for filtering supervisor evaluation search results within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for review ID and self-evaluation indicator.

classes.name: SupervisorEvaluationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for supervisor evaluation search filters, including review ID and self-evaluation indicators.

methods.name: getReviewId
methods.description: Returns the review ID used for filtering.

methods.name: setReviewId
methods.description: Sets the review ID for filtering.
